name: al-Ṣāḥib Abū al-Qāsim Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAbbād
summary: Vizier of the Būyids in Rayy, pupil of Ibn Fāris and of Ibn al-ʿAmīd, man of letters and patron, author of the dictionary al-Muḥīṭ fī al-lugha.
bio: Ibn al-Anbārī calls al-Ṣāḥib a man of abundant learning in many sciences, a pupil of Ibn Fāris and of the vizier Abū al-Faḍl ibn al-ʿAmīd, and tells his witty answer on his return from Baghdad: 'Baghdad among towns is like the Master among men.'
As vizier of the Būyid princes Muʾayyid al-Dawla and Fakhr al-Dawla he gathered poets and scholars at Rayy. He died in 385/995.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 397–401
Sâhib b. Abbâd, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
